about_the_game:
🍬 Gummy Bear Idle – Morning Call Voice DLC

Waking up isn’t about going to work.
It’s about being gently nagged awake by a lazy piece of jelly.

You don’t want to wake up.
She doesn’t either.
But Gummy Bear will still try (kind of).
With sleepy mumbles, shameless whining, and some suspiciously passive-aggressive sweetness,
she’ll do her best (bare minimum) to drag you out of bed.

📦 Includes:

💗 Multiple fully-voiced morning call lines

🛌 “Let’s just... stay in bed together a little longer...”

🐾 Gummy-flavored encouragement × zero actual motivation:
“I can’t go to work for you…
But I can help you slack off emotionally.”

🌞 The perfect way to start your day by not wanting to start your day—
Let a pink, lazy, emotionally codependent blob of jelly try (and fail) to wake you up.
